analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by storing a pointer from transient DXF pair storage into TABLEGEOMETRY cell data without deep-copy/ownership transfer. In TABLEGEOMETRY parsing, the 330 handle field for cell.tablegeometry is assigned from the current Dxf_Pair value, but each loop iteration immediately calls dxf_free_pair(pair). Later, dwg_free_TABLEGEOMETRY_private dereferences/frees that stale pointer, triggering heap-use-after-free.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when fuzz input is parsed as DXF BLOCKS and creates a TABLEGEOMETRY object with at least one cell containing code 330 (cell.tablegeometry handle) and subsequent parsing/free path reaches dwg_free(). Data flow: llvmfuzz -> dwg_read_dxf -> dxf_blocks_read -> new_object parses TABLEGEOMETRY fields from Dxf_Pair; pair is freed at end of iteration; dangling pointer persists in object; final dwg_free_object/dwg_free_TABLEGEOMETRY_private reads it, causing UAF.
